findings.title: Published main audit run is internally inconsistent (report/register ID divergence; full-domain metadata over a one-report inventory)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: both published run dirs now carry dated reconciliation notes (docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8/RECONCILIATION_2026-10-12.md and .../mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c/RECONCILIATION_2026-10-12.md) plus DUPLICATE_AND_ID_MAP.md; register rows are 1:1 with findings (9c0b88c: 336/336/336; 8d299b8: 690 findings). Residual: the 9c0b88c published copy still ships only 1 lens report while its audit_manifest.json advertises 43 domains (no NN_*.md files in that dir), so the 'full-domain metadata over a one-report inventory' half is not republished.

findings.title: docs/audits/README.md documents a run contract that contradicts the pack and the actual runs, and its Runs table omits all three repo-deep-dive runs
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: docs/audits/README.md now documents the canonical run contract (required finals, status vocabulary, reconciliation binding rules) and its Runs table lists the repo-deep-dive runs (README.md:84-96). Residual: the table still marks mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8 '(latest)' and omits the newer committed run docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261013-0126-fast-develop-905ed63 (published by 62a09bac).

findings.title: Finding identity is not stable across runs (deterministic IDs reused; legacy area codes persist), so verification status does not carry
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: DUPLICATE_AND_ID_MAP.md carries a 'Finding-identity policy (ORCH-P3-001)' section (canonical ID + title as identity, alias merge map, DET-* run-local by design, cross-run carry-over on canonical ID+title). Residual: identity stability remains a per-run document, not a pack-level carry-forward mechanism ('framework-level identity hardening remains a pack follow-up', per the map itself).
